value.rationale: Full finite classification of a canonical minimal asymmetric cubic graph is natural and interpretable. All ten five-cycle attractors have basins strictly exceeding each of 1024 four-cycle attractors, a nontrivial distinction between orbit abundance and random-initial-state likelihood. Sharp 27-entry tail and exact basins give concrete test data for multicolor excitation on irregular networks, not a routine small improvement.
